1  HON'BLE ABDUL SHAHID, J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Perused the impugned order.

2. The instant revision has been filed with a prayer to set aside the order dated 3.8.2024 passed by the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Mainpuri, in Special Trial No. 99 of 2024, State Vs. Ram Saran @ Tillu and others), arising out of case crime no. 223 of 2024, under Sections 376(2)(N), 506 IPC and Section 5 J(ii), 5L/6 and 16/17 POCSO Act, 2012, Police Station Karhal, Disstrictd Mainpuri whereby the trial court has framed the charges under Sections under Sections 376(2)(N)/114, 506 IPC and Section 5(1) read with Section 6, 16 read with Section 17 of POCSO Act as well as 5 J(ii) read with Section 16/17 POCSO Act, 2012.

entities.text: State Vs. Ram Saran @ Tillu and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. The brief contents of the facts is that the FIR has been lodged by the complainant, father of the victim.
The victim was minor.
The revisionist had supported main accused Ram Saran @ Tillu in committing rape on minor.
She became pregnant.
After complete the investigation, the charge sheet has been filed against Ram Saran @ Tillu, under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 IPC and Section 5 j(ii), 5l/6 POCSO Act, 2012.
Revisionist has been charge sheeted under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 IPC and Section 5 j(ii), 5l/6 & 16,17 POCSO Act, 2012.
The complainant as well as victim has supported the prosecution story and their statements duly recorded by the investigating officer.
4. Learned counsel for the revisionist has submitted that there are contradictions in the statements of the victim and the prosecution story.
There is no role of the revisionist in the said offence.

5. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has opposed the revision and contented that the revisionist has committed the said offence.
6.

After appreciation of the evidences collected by the investigating officer, learned trial court has framed the charges against co-accused Ram Saran @ Tillu and revisionist/Rakhi Alias Rakhi Devi and the charges have been framed against the main accused under Sections 376(2)(n), 506 IPC and Section 5 j(ii), 5l/6 POCSO Act, 2012
whereas against the revisionist under Sections 376(2)(n)/114 IPC and Section 5(l),6, 16 r/w 17 POCSO Act, 2012.
Any appreciation of facts could not be justifiable at this stage.
7. In view thereof, there is no illegality or irregularity in the impugned order and the revision is liable to be dismissed.
It is dismissed, accordingly.
